key_moments: 7' Goal: Ousmane Dembélé (France) opens the scoring with an assist from Kylian Mbappé.
32' Goal: Ousmane Dembélé (France) completes his hat-trick, becoming the second-earliest hat-trick scorer in World Cup history.
50' Penalty Miss: Jørgen Strand Larsen (Norway) misses a penalty, saved by Mike Maignan (France).
74' Yellow Card: Aurélien Tchouaméni (France) receives a yellow card for a serious foul.

standout_performers.reason: Scored a sensational first-half hat-trick, demonstrating clinical finishing and pace.
Provided two crucial assists and was a constant threat, despite not scoring himself.
Scored Norway's only goal, becoming the youngest Norwegian player to score at a World Cup.

matches.tactical_summary: France's 4-2-3-1 formation effectively exploited Norway's defensive vulnerabilities, especially in transition, leading to a dominant first-half performance. Norway, playing a 4-3-3 with a heavily rotated squad, struggled to contain France's attacking rotations and lacked a consistent threat despite pulling one goal back.

narrative: France secured a dominant 4-1 victory over Norway, with Ousmane Dembélé's first-half hat-trick sealing their perfect record and top spot in Group I. Despite Norway's efforts, including a penalty save by Mike Maignan, France's attacking prowess proved too much, setting them up as strong contenders for the knockout stages.
